desc:
average jjk battleground game but way more stand out
this game has many variety of each moves, like one moveset can have over 20 skills!!
there also a unique questline for exclusive variant

currently only support on PC and MOBILE

-PC Keybinds-
1,2,3,4 - main moves
5 - utility/ultimate move
R - variant mode
M1 - punch
Q - dash (while ragdolled become evasive)
F - block
G - awakening

based on jujutsu kaisen show/manga
